question: A sum amounts to ₹11,616 in 2 years and to ₹12,777.60 in 3 years, when the interest is compounded annually. The sum (in ₹) is:
solution:
**Given:**

A sum amounts to ₹11,616 in 2 years and to ₹12,777.60 in 3 years

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

A = Amounts

P = Principal 

r = Rate

t = time

**Calculation:**

Let principal be P

and rate be r

According to the question,

11616 = P(1 + r/100)²

12777.6 = P(1 + r/100)³

So, P(1 + r/100)3/P(1 + r/100)2 = 12777.6/11616

⇒ (1 + r/100) = 1.1

Now, 11616 = P(1 + r/100)2

11616 = P(1.1)²

⇒ 11616/1.21 = P

⇒ P = 9600

So, principal = Rs. 9600

**∴ The sum is Rs. 9600**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**We know that C.I increase in GP

Ratio of Amount 

3 years : 2 years

12777.6 : 11616

11 : 10

So, Ratio of 2nd year : 1st year = 11 : 10

So, Ratio of 1st year : Initial = 11 : 10

So, Sum = 11616 × 10/11 × 10/11

**∴ Rs. 9600**
